aboutFaq.title: Know more about us!

faqItems.question: How does donesi.me work?
faqItems.answer: Choose a restaurant, add dishes to your cart and pay online or on delivery. Your order is delivered directly to your address.

faqItems.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
faqItems.answer: We accept online card payments, as well as cash or card payments when your order is delivered.

faqItems.question: Can I track my order in real time?
faqItems.answer: Yes. From the moment your order is accepted until delivery, you can follow its status and the courier’s live location.

faqItems.question: Are there any special discounts or promotions?
faqItems.answer: We regularly offer discounts for selected restaurants and first orders. Check the homepage for current offers.

faqItems.question: Is donesi.me available in my city?
faqItems.answer: We currently cover Podgorica, with plans to expand to other cities across Montenegro soon.
